name: frame-debugger-control
description: Opens/focuses the Unity Frame Debugger window and adjusts enabled/event state. Compact output reports only agent-usable Frame Debugger state.

enabled.description: Set enabled state through the Frame Debugger window when available; reported state uses FrameDebugger.enabled.

eventIndex.description: Zero-based frame event index to select via FrameDebuggerTreeView when supported.

eventLimit.description: One-based FrameDebuggerUtility.limit value to apply via FrameDebuggerWindow.ChangeFrameEventLimit when supported.
